cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(corad_cpp VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(TRISTAN_MKL_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Audited MKL2023.1 installation")
find_library(CORAD_MKL NAMES mkl_rt libmkl_rt.so.2 PATHS "${TRISTAN_MKL_ROOT}/lib" REQUIRED)
add_library(corad_rank STATIC src/canonical/cpython_powersort.c)
target_compile_options(corad_rank PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
add_library(corad STATIC src/canonical/codec.cpp third_party/tristan/src/canonical/numerical.cpp)
target_include_directories(corad PUBLIC include third_party/tristan/include PRIVATE third_party/tristan/src/canonical)
target_link_libraries(corad PUBLIC corad_rank "${CORAD_MKL}" pthread m dl)
target_compile_options(corad PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
option(TRISTAN_SANITIZE "ASan/UBSan" OFF)
option(TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE "Separate TSan" OFF)
if(TRISTAN_SANITIZE AND TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ASan and TSan must be separate")
endif()
foreach(target corad corad_rank)
  if(TRISTAN_SANITIZE)
    target_compile_options(${target} PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(${target} PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
  endif()
  if(TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE)
    target_compile_options(${target} PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(${target} PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread)
  endif()
endforeach()
add_executable(corad_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(corad_cli PRIVATE corad)
enable_testing()
add_executable(corad_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(corad_preflight PRIVATE corad)
add_test(NAME preflight COMMAND corad_preflight)
